description:
A public Telegram channel's header (counters, description) plus its latest messages (up to 100) with text, media, views and dates.
Cost: 2 credits per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: username (string), name (string), is_verified (boolean), description (string), photo_url (string, nullable), subscriber_count (integer, nullable), subscriber_count_text (string, nullable), photo_count (integer, nullable), video_count (integer, nullable), file_count (integer, nullable), link_count (integer, nullable), link (string), posts_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean), posts (array<object>).

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return. Example: 25

username.description: Public channel username, @handle or t.me link. Example: "durov"

name: telegram_posts
title: Telegram channel posts
